items.title: U.S. inflation data ahead; Huang scandal fallout - what’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices hover around both sides of the flatline, as investors await key inflation figures and assess fragile sentiment around the artificial intelligence trade. Oil falls to roughly $90 a barrel on hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the Iran war, while Nvidia shares tick higher in after-hours trading following a selloff on Monday triggered by a scandal surrounding CEO Jensen Huang.
